datasets.name: BigEarthNet
datasets.summary: Large-scale Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 benchmark for multi-label land-cover classification.
datasets.description: BigEarthNet is a large-scale benchmark archive of Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 image patches annotated with multiple land-cover labels from the CORINE Land Cover map. It was designed to support deep learning for remote sensing image understanding at scale. Version 1.0 provides 590,326 Sentinel-2 patches; the 2024 reBEN (v2.0) release refines the label nomenclature and geographic splits and provides 549,488 patches with paired Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 data.
